exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-08-22 to 2026-08-28): growthbook.io had 3,227 sessions and 1,739 users (-62.3% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 3,227 sessions (-62.3% WoW) | 1,739 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,727 clicks (+12.4% WoW) | 236,930 impressions (-1.0% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 2,003 GA4 sessions (-54.3% WoW) all-traffic | 1,914 GSC clicks (+18.1% WoW) organic | 9,744 GSC impressions (+4.8% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 508 GA4 sessions (-36.3% WoW) all-traffic | 104 GSC clicks (+25.3% WoW) organic | 4,669 GSC impressions (+2.5% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 3,212 GA4 sessions (-23.9% WoW) all-traffic | 1,046 GSC clicks (+1.2% WoW) organic | 73,860 GSC impressions (-13.4% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 1,680 GA4 sessions (-65.9% WoW) all-traffic | 671 GSC clicks (+14.7% WoW) organic | 226,218 GSC impressions (+2.6% WoW)
- GA4 sessions are down sharply (-62.3% WoW) for the second consecutive week while GSC organic clicks are up across every section. The divergence has accelerated: all-other-pages GSC clicks +14.7% while GA4 sessions -65.9%. This is a strong and worsening AI-search-displacement signal — Google organic is surfacing GrowthBook content more but clicks are being absorbed before reaching the site. Worth confirming whether a UTM or tracking change is compounding the GA4 drop.

**New competitor activity**
- **LaunchDarkly** published two tier-1 blogs this week: **"ML Experiment Tracking"** (KD 13, threat score 7) and **"MLOps Experiment Tracking"** -- a coordinated push into the ML/AI experimentation space. GrowthBook has no dedicated page on either topic. LaunchDarkly also shipped 6 AgentControl changelog entries signaling continued AI-agent feature investment (EU data residency, Go/Java SDKs, Amazon Bedrock, LiteLLM gateway).
- **Flagsmith** published **"Multivariate Testing"** (KD 17, tier 1) -- direct overlap with GrowthBook's core A/B testing positioning. This continues last week's sustained push into GrowthBook's content territory.
- **Unleash** published two tier-3 posts (GitOps/feature decisions, release risk reduction) -- below the core relevance bar but consistent with their platform-engineer positioning.
- **Amplitude Exp** shipped 4 pages below relevance, **Harness** 28 pages below relevance, **PostHog** 8 pages below relevance, **Datadog** 8 pages below relevance -- none in core topics this week.
- ⚠️ Zero pages detected from **Eppo**, **Kameleoon**, **Optimizely**, and **Statsig** -- likely a monitoring gap for at least some of these.

**New GrowthBook content**
- **/blog/how-to-reduce-deployment-risk-with-canary-releases-and-feature-flags** (published 2026-07-27): 8 clicks, 1,974 impressions, pos 6.2 -- recovering after last week's steep drop; worth watching to confirm the rebound holds.
- **/blog/variance-reduction-ab-testing** (published 2026-07-30): 12 clicks, 1,228 impressions, pos 7.2 -- new to tracking; in striking distance, needs internal links to build equity.
- **/blog/how-to-implement-feature-flags-at-scale** (published 2026-05-26): 41 clicks, 18,511 impressions, pos 11.6 -- slight click decline from 47 last week; impression-to-click gap persists, answer-capsule H2 remains the lever.
- **Seven new zero-impression pages noticed this week** (all detected 2026-08-29, real publish dates unknown): **/blog/bad-controls**, **/blog/clover-ben-schein-experimentation**, **/blog/design-experiments-trustworthy-results**, **/blog/feature-flag-vs-remote-configuration**, **/blog/introducing-learnings**, **/blog/jobleads-zero-impact-experiment**, **/blog/segment-analysis-experimentation** -- all need internal links to get indexed. **/blog/feature-flag-vs-remote-configuration** and **/blog/introducing-learnings** are highest-priority for internal linking given topic relevance.
